name: cult-ui-code-block
blurb: Tabbed code viewer with spring-animated tab indicator and copy button.
description: Client component rendering code in tabs (or solo) with a bottom-border indicator that springs to the active tab. Supports copy-to-clipboard with animated icon transition. Tab switching slides code in/out with blur effect. Horizontal scrollbar appears only when code overflows.
use_when: Showing code examples with language variants (TypeScript vs JavaScript, install vs usage).
avoid_when: Very long code that scrolls heavily on smaller screens; animations impact performance on slower devices.
a11y: Tab bar uses role=tablist and buttons have aria-selected. Copy button is labeled and focus-visible. No prefers-reduced-motion support.
